Title: Home
Content: Learn how estate planning helps families prepare for the future. Our team discusses probate administration and trust administration questions before they become stressful.

Title: Estate Planning | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Estate planning helps families prepare wills, trusts, and instructions for their future. A comprehensive plan may include powers of attorney and special needs trusts when relevant.

Title: Probate Administration | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Probate administration may involve inventorying assets, paying debts, and distributing property after a death. Families who completed estate planning beforehand may still have probate questions.

Title: Trust Administration | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Trust administration involves managing and distributing trust assets according to the trust instructions. Families may review powers of attorney and probate administration questions with counsel.

Title: Powers of Attorney | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Powers of attorney let someone act for another person under specific circumstances. These documents often complement estate planning and special needs trusts strategies.

Title: Special Needs Trusts | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Special needs trusts can help some families plan for a person with a disability. The trust terms and trust administration process are important considerations.

Title: Business Succession Planning | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Business succession planning helps owners prepare leadership and ownership transitions. Depending on the situation, estate planning and trust administration may be relevant.

Title: First Estate Plan Checklist | Northstar Legal Example
Content: An estate planning checklist starts with your assets, key people, and legal documents. Families often ask whether powers of attorney should be created alongside wills and trusts. Probate administration can be relevant when planning for loved ones.

Title: Trustee Duties Guide | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Trust administration starts with understanding what the trustee must do. The trustee may coordinate with a professional about probate administration in some situations. Special needs trusts can create additional duties.

Title: Business Owners and Legacy Planning | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Business succession planning can reduce uncertainty when an owner retires or dies. Estate planning should also address family goals and key decision makers. Powers of attorney may be relevant during incapacity.

Title: Family Planning for Care | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Special needs trusts may support long-term planning in some family circumstances. A family may also consider powers of attorney and estate planning when reviewing arrangements for care.

Title: After a Death: Practical Next Steps | Northstar Legal Example
Content: Probate administration often begins with information gathering and notice requirements. Trust administration may also require coordination with beneficiaries. The role of estate planning is to document choices in advance.
